Home.heroDescription: Choose your dhikr and target count, and let the app automatically track your recitations using voice recognition.

ZekrSelector.title: Select the dhikr
ZekrSelector.description: Select the dhikr that the AI will listen for

Counter.title: Select the Number of Repetitions
Counter.description: How many times would you like to perform this dhikr?

Ringtone.title: Select the Alert Tone

Privacy.title: Voice Privacy Protection
Privacy.description: All audio processing is done on your device. Audio data is never saved or sent to the cloud.
